profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
***Not Currently Pursuing New Career Opportunities***
Entry level Computer Engineer graduating May, 2018. 2 Years of demonstrated experience working in the Software Industry as a Lockheed Martin Intern. Skilled in C++, Java, CMOS FPGA Development, and Electrical Circuits Analysis and Design.
3.6 GPA

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer - UCF/Lockheed Martin CWEP Participant
positions.description:
Participant in the UCF/Lockheed Martin College Work Experience Program (CWEP) as an Embedded Systems Engineer.
This program is a partnership between UCF and Lockheed Martin wherein the participant works at Lockheed Martin, however, the participant is employed by UCF.
Duties on the job primarily entailed writing C++ programs to be executed on Embedded Systems, and configuring the electrical hardware needed for the specific tasks.
Other programming languages include C, Bash, VBA, Python, XML

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineering for all levels of Embedded Systems Software Development
Primary languages: C++, C, XML, VBA, Bash, Python

positions.title: Supplemental Instructor
positions.description:
Organizing and conducting General Chemistry I and College Algebra study sessions.
Tutoring General Chemistry I and College Algebra.

positions.title: Atlas Lab Specialist
positions.description: Performing task involving www.Atlas.ValenciaCollele.edu, www.DynamicForms.ngwebsolutions.com, www.FAFSA.ed.gov, and nearly any technical issues involving the Atlas Computer Lab.

volunteerExperiences.description: Conducting free health lecture and performing several free blood analysis for individuals, and answering questions concerning health related topics.
